message.content: In Miami, the primary train hub is **Miami Central Station** (also known as the Miami Intermodal Center). While the station itself doesn’t have a dedicated “pet‑friendly” designation, Amtrak’s policy allows small dogs in carriers on board their trains. If you’re traveling by train from this station, you’ll be able to bring your dog along under those conditions.
